Description: Operations Manager persona. Requirement: Dashboard displays live vehicle status and energy consumption; scheduling for charges.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Dashboard shows live status for 10 vehicles with JSON telemetry; 2) Updates within 5s of event; 3) Scheduling UI creates charge windows.

Description: Operations Manager persona. Requirement: Scheduler creates charging windows and applies tariffs; supports bulk scheduling.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Scheduler sets off-peak windows and assigns to groups of vehicles; 2) Applies tariff model to calculate cost; 3) Schedules execute at off-peak at least 90% of the time.

Summary: REQ-003: Mobile app with offline navigation
Description: Field Technician persona. Requirement: App preserves job data offline and syncs when online; offline nav available.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) App records 20 job entries offline and syncs without data loss; 2) Offline navigation provides route and waypoints; 3) Sync latency within 30s after connectivity.

Description: Executive Stakeholder persona. Requirement: Automated KPI rollups and sustainability metrics are available daily.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Daily report generation completes within 5 minutes; 2) KPI calculations reconcile to raw data within 0.5%; 3) Dashboard presents trend views and export options.

Summary: REQ-006: Export and API access to vehicle/energy data
Description: Data Analyst persona. Requirement: APIs expose historical and real-time data with documented schema.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) API endpoints return historical 24-hour data and real-time streams; 2) Returned schema matches documentation; 3) Data completeness >99% for test dataset.

Description: IT Administrator persona. Requirement: OTAs delivered securely, versioned, and rollback supported.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Deploy OTA to 5 test vehicles; 2) Verify versioning and ability to rollback; 3) No bricking or unrecoverable state.

Description: Fleet Manager persona. Requirement: Alerts generated with recommended actions and confidence scores.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Simulated faults generate alerts with >=80% precision; 2) Recommended actions are provided and actionable; 3) Alerts reduce unplanned downtime in simulation.

Description: Government/Institutional Buyer persona. Requirement: Documentation bundle provided for procurement and audit.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Compliance pack contains all checklist items; 2) Documents pass internal review; 3) Pack exports to PDF/ZIP for RFP attachments.

Description: Create a standing policy-watch brief and stakeholder tracker for the EU 2035 review and related trade/tariff signals.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Weekly brief produced; 2) Stakeholder positions documented and 3 recommended program triggers identified; 3) PMO triage card created.
